title: What Is the Traveler?
disclaimer: Unofficial fan-made educational video. Not affiliated with Bungie.

scenes.narration: Above humanity's Last City floats a mysterious sphere called the Traveler. But what exactly is it?
Long ago, the Traveler arrived in our solar system. Its presence helped humanity enter a Golden Age of discovery, technology, and longer lives.
Then came the Collapse. A terrible catastrophe devastated civilization. The Traveler remained on Earth, while humanity struggled to survive.
Afterward, the Traveler released Ghosts: small, independent companions that search for people they can bring back as Lightbearers. Some become Guardians, defenders of the Last City.
With their Ghosts, Guardians can wield the Light and return from death, though that power has limits, and a Ghost can be destroyed.
Even now, the Traveler remains one of Destiny's greatest mysteries: a source of hope, power, and questions still unanswered.
